variants.name: mc-off
variants.note: live without live_midcycle: the execution ablation's number, the anchor

variants.name: live
variants.note: the full live execution policy, the control

variants.name: mc-target-size
variants.note: breakout entries sized straight to the policy's equal-weight target for the name that session, less what is held, instead of entry_size(band)

variants.name: mc-no-idle-cash
variants.note: the live rule plus a sweep: cash the plan would leave beyond the policy's own idle share is redeployed pro rata to the held names each session instead of waiting for a breakout

variants.name: mc-new-grades-only
variants.note: no band trigger: only a name the policy would hold today that it did not hold at the last rebalance enters, at its target weight

variants.name: mc-exit-only
variants.note: rotation exits only: a name losing its grade leaves and its proceeds are redeployed pro rata; no mid-cycle entries

variants.name: mc-redeploy
variants.note: the live rule plus the reset's own buy semantics whenever cash accumulates: on every mid-cycle session cash beyond a 2% buffer goes back to the allocator's targets pro rata to each held A/A+ name's shortfall (and to names graded in since the reset), no band gate, nothing deferred or dropped; sells unchanged

variants.name: mc-redeploy-nobuffer
variants.note: mc-redeploy with no cash buffer: what the 2% buffer costs

variants.name: mc-redeploy-no-exits
variants.note: mc-redeploy without the rotation sells: no name leaves between resets, only the reset rotates; against mc-redeploy this separates what the exits earn in drawdown from what the idle cash costs

variants.name: reset-full-invest
variants.note: mc-off with the reset topping itself up the session after: the cash the reset's sells delivered at the close and the deferred retry could not place (band gate, the 15% retry cap under a 20% target, the trade floor) goes back to today's targets; the cash mc-off holds beyond the allocator's own cap is this leak

note: Every variant is one registered trial, fixed in VARIANTS before the run: the full live execution policy with the mid-cycle rule alone modified. Lines priced on identical sessions from each of the first `offsets` sessions of the restricted report with policy_v4's allocator; medians and worsts across offsets; paired statistics at the median offset against live and against mc-off; diagnostics are medians across offsets of what a passive ledger read off each run.
